_doc: Stage 02 gutter-split ground truth. Each entry: expected gutter column (x, in original 4000-wide anchor pixels) and a pixel tolerance, OR {"single": true} for a genuine single page. gutter_x-near-GT is a STAGE-02 PROXY for the real consequence (cross-gutter reading-order scramble, which is downstream at Stage 04); a hit means the two facing pages are cleanly separated. Provenance: flat spreads anchored to the known-good ink-valley split column (visually validated, Gate-1/3 era); the three curved spreads (de_01/de_02 and the out-of-testset taleb_bg) hand-labelled from the visible spine in the debug overlay, INDEPENDENT of the pinch detector they validate. de_* anchors are the orientation-normalized landscape (orient_fix jobs). Append-only per testset/README.md. ZOOMSET ADDENDUM 2026-08-19: the four real handheld lap captures (zoomset_*) are labelled here too. Provenance: hand-read off the full-resolution Stage 01 anchor at 1.3x zoom with a 50-px ruler overlay, by locating the left page's right edge and the right page's first content column and taking the midpoint of that band — INDEPENDENT of every cue stage02_split computes. Read bands (left_edge..right_start, original px): de_01 1655..1698, de_02 1603..1660, en_01 1585..1646, en_02 1658..1665. NOTE de_02's label lands within 1 px of the shipped detector's own answer; that is expected (de_02 is the one spread it already got right) and the label was read before the detector was re-run on it, not fitted to it. Each anchor is pixel-identical to the committed testset JPEG named in `anchor`, so these rows need no gitignored jobs/ input — unlike the de_01/de_02 rows above, which read from jobs/orient_fix_de*.
_tol_note: tol is generous (~3-5% of width): the 2*margin cut overlap absorbs sub-tolerance error, so the metric only flags gross mis-splits, not pixel drift.
